natural_language_statement:
Call a subset of positive integers admissible if it contains no $a<b<c$ satisfying $a(b+c)=bc$, equivalently $1/a=1/b+1/c$. Let $f(n)$ denote the maximum cardinality of an admissible subset of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. Assuming an attained maximum and matching upper bound $f(731)=606$, one has

$$
f(733)=607.
$$

The baseline at 731 is an explicit hypothesis. This theorem proves a finite conditional transfer; it does not prove that baseline, a lower-bound table, or the asymptotic Erdős conjecture.
